<thought>To find the precursors, I first need the appropriate retrosynthetic template for the intramolecular carbonyl‑ene reaction described. I will search the template catalog for a template that breaks a ketone (C=O) and an alkene (C=C) and forms a C‑C bond and an alcohol, matching the forward reaction details. Then I will apply that template to the target molecule (converted to a plain SMILES string) to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC C C1(OH)C(F)(F)F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkene"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alcohol"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"]
}</action_input>
